description: This file defines an enum 'FileLog' responsible for managing file-based logging, including writing log messages with timestamps, handling log file creation, and closing logs.

classes.name: FileLog
classes.description: An enum singleton that manages logging to files and console, including opening, writing, and closing log files.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the log file stream if not already opened.

methods.name: openLog
methods.description: Creates a new log file with timestamp-based naming and returns its output stream.

methods.name: createFolderIfNeeded
methods.description: Ensures that the output directory exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date and time formatted as 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH_mm_ss'.

methods.name: logLine
methods.description: Logs a single line with a timestamp, prints to console, and writes to file if logging is active.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the log file output stream.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs an exception's stack trace to the file.

methods.name: logException
methods.description: Logs a message and exception stack trace.
